title: Turn the capacity gate on for the martianrover workspace
problem: The live workspace config sets codingAgent.capacityGateEnabled: false, so every provider reads "unmetered by config". Decision 0130's read-only Claude usage check with its 80% cap, and the pre-admission usage refresh from PR #1492, therefore never apply. Decision 0123 makes removing that flag operator-owned, and the operator never runs host commands.
desired_effect: Turns the capacity gate on: Claude launches are then admitted only on a fresh read-only usage reading; Codex/OpenCode without fresh readings are refused. Mechanically: while managed production reads Inactive, removes exactly the key capacityGateEnabled (pinned value false) from the codingAgent object of /Users/pmark/Dev/MR/Arcadia/workspaces/martianrover/config/arcadia.json, leaving every other field and value unchanged, and writes a receipt with the before and after sha256.

does: Resolves the workspace the ordinary way and refuses unless it is exactly the pinned /Users/pmark/Dev/MR/Arcadia/workspaces/martianrover.
Refuses unless the config is canonical JSON and codingAgent.capacityGateEnabled reads exactly false (drift refusal; absent means the gate is already on).
Refuses while managed production is Active, and fails closed when production state cannot be read.

Removes that one key with an atomic rewrite, re-reads it through the real config loader to prove the gate is enforced for every provider, and records before/after sha256 and both images in the run directory.
never_does: Never changes any other config field, the database, production policy, a Plan, a Decision, a Grant or a service.
Never starts, restarts or stops a Session, worker or service; already-running work is untouched (production must be Off anyway).
Never runs twice: a recorded success refuses every later press, and the inverse (adding capacityGateEnabled: false back) is not built as a card.
Never calls a provider or reads a credential.

success.effect: codingAgent.capacityGateEnabled is absent from the martianrover config, so the capacity gate is on for every provider. The receipt records the before/after sha256.
success.next: Claude launches are admitted only on a fresh read-only usage reading (Decision 0130, 80% cap); Codex/OpenCode without fresh readings are refused. To undo, the operator decides separately to add "capacityGateEnabled": false back inside codingAgent while production is Off.

failure.effect: Nothing was changed. The receipt names the refusal: PRODUCTION_ACTIVE_FREEZE, PRECONDITION_DRIFT, WORKSPACE_DRIFT, NONCANONICAL_CONFIG, ALREADY_APPLIED or PRODUCTION_FREEZE_UNVERIFIED.
failure.next: PRODUCTION_ACTIVE_FREEZE: turn production Off on /production, then press again. PRECONDITION_DRIFT showing the field absent: the gate is already on, nothing to do. Any other drift: ask for a freshly pinned card.
